messages:
ci-bot: nightly-ci perf-check FAILED for runtime perf suite (commit: abcdef1) — p50 increased from 15ms -> 21ms (+40%), p99 spike observed. Affected model: gpt-small. Full run: https://ci.redwood/in/1750004321

maria: seeing the alert, thanks. Is this isolated to a specific benchmark or across suites?

sam: looks concentrated in decode/attention paths for seq_len 1024 from the quick diff. Not across all models.

devin: uploaded artifacts: https://s3.redwood-ci/nightly/1750004321/ — includes perf diff and flamegraphs. Diff highlights attention_forward and kv-cache merge spending more cycles.

maria: any recent infra or runtime changes rolled in last 24h? kernel selection changes?

akshay: there's a small reorder in kernel probe logic in PR #4823 that landed yesterday (changed preferred kernel ordering to favor new fused kernels). Logs show a fallback to aten_attn_fused_v2 for some shards. I'll check kernel-selection logs/flags.

sam: can we repro locally with the nightly config? Use: `./tools/run_bench.py --model gpt-small --seq_len 1024 --batch 1 --runs 100 --commit abcdef1` and `--no-cache` to avoid prefix caching differences.

devin: I ran that command with --no-cache and see the same p50 regression. Flame diff: https://s3.redwood-ci/nightly/1750004321/flame-diff.svg — attention_forward via quantized path is hotter.

akshay: checked runtime logs: `select_kernel: aten_attn_fused_v2 (fallback)` right before decode. The reorder apparently causes selection of an experimental fused kernel which falls back to slower codegen for certain sequence lengths. Reverting that reorder locally gives p50 back to ~16ms.

ci-bot: created perf-triage issue #perf-triage/1750004321 and attached CI artifacts.

maria: assigning to @akshay to validate revert and open a rollback PR if confirmed. @sam can you prepare a canary pool to validate?

akshay: will open PR with revert (draft PR #4890) and run the same bench. If green, request merge + canary.

sam: queuing canary on dedicated pool `pool-dedicated-us-west-2` and tagging @eng-oncall. Canary run link: https://console.redwood/metrics/canary/1750004321

ops-bot: Canary started: canary-1750004321 (pool-dedicated-us-west-2). Monitoring active; alerting on >10% p50 regression.

akshay: local revert results: p50 = 16ms, p99 stable. Pushing PR now.

maria: plan: if canary shows no regression in 30m, merge revert and cut patch release. Notify support to expect minimal user-facing impact.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll keep watch and post updates in the issue thread.

maria: thanks everyone — nice quick triage.
